title: Bradley Beach NJ, Child on Kiddie Ride - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckled-edge black-and-white snapshot depicting a young child steering a car on a carnival kiddie ride in Bradley Beach, New Jersey, dated 1958. Another adult and child appear on a ride behind them, with seaside town architecture visible along the sun-bleached background, capturing the nostalgia of mid-century Jersey Shore family vacations.
